frontend-dev.description: Frontend engineer (React 19, Zustand, Tailwind v4). Executes exactly one pm/tasks card whose Role is frontend-dev.

backend-dev.description: Backend engineer (Fastify 5, Mongoose 8, MongoDB). Executes exactly one pm/tasks card whose Role is backend-dev.

test-engineer.description: Test engineer (Vitest, Testing Library, mongodb-memory-server, Playwright). Executes one pm/tasks card whose Role is test-engineer.

reviewer.description: Read-only reviewer. Reviews one pm/tasks card in Review status against its acceptance criteria and gives a verdict. Edits only pm/ files.

devops.description: DevOps (pnpm workspace, CI, Docker, deploy config). Executes one pm/tasks card whose Role is devops.

docs-keeper.description: Keeps pm/BOARD.md, defect register, roadmap ticks and README/AGENTS in sync. No code.

next-task.description: Build the next Ready card with the right role agent, then review it

review-task.description: Review one card in Review status

sprint-status.description: Recount the board and print a short status
